description:
An animated adaptation of Vivaldi's The Four Seasons, each movement directed and animated by different directors:
Spring - Anna Budanova
Summer - Priit Pärn & Olga Pärn
Autumn - Atsushi Wada
Winter - Theodore Ushev

Crowdfunded via READYFOR and premiered as a live concert, the recorded performance was released on DVD to backers of the campaign.
